Type: table
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Bernice Industrial Reclaimed Fir Wood Side End Table, 20"W, Natural and Black
Colors: Natural/Black
Materials: wood
Beautiful parquet-patterned wood is paired with modern black-finished metal for the ultimate mix of rustic, modern and industrial styles. Made of reclaimed fir wood, it's a style focal point along with serving as a side table. 19.7"W x 19.7"D x 19.7"H; Leg Height: 4.92"H Reclaimed fir wood top and lower shelf, metal legs Rustic, modern and industrial styles combine in a piece that will blend with most any room Ideal table next to a sofa for a lamp; lower shelf provides extra storage No assembly required Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
